DIAGNOSIS READY: Lyme Disease. Your recent camping exposure, combined with systemic symptoms (fatigue, weakness) and a history of multiple illnesses, strongly suggests a tick-borne infection despite normal initial labs, which can occur in early localized or early disseminated stages before antibodies are detectable or if the specific assay was not performed immediately after exposure. I recommend treating empirically with doxycycline pending further imaging or serology confirmation if available.

REQUEST IMAGES: Please provide any photographs of potential tick bites, rashes (especially erythema migrans), or other skin lesions.
